Radisys Corporation provides software defined infrastructure, service aware traffic distribution platforms, real-time media processing engines, and wireless access technologies. The company has market cap of $27.80 million. It operates in two divisions, Software-Systems and Hardware Solutions. It currently has negative earnings. The companyÂ’s products include FlowEngine, which comprises data plane traffic distribution products that classify and distribute session data flows to network processing resources; and MediaEngine products that provide media processing capabilities required for applications, such as voice over long-term evolution , voice over Wi-Fi, Web real-time communication, and multimedia conferencing, as well as media interworking.
